_note: Bổ sung A2 theo danh sách Cambridge A2 Flyers / A2 Key (27/10/2026, Claude soạn, chưa người thật kiểm). Áp bằng node tools/fix-pre.mjs.

units.vi: Bổ sung Key 1: giao tiếp hằng ngày

words.en: used to say yes politely or to show something is clear
words.ex: “Can I sit here?” “Of course.”
words.exVi: “Tôi ngồi đây được không?” “Tất nhiên.”

cloze.s: “Can you help me?” “___! What do you need?”

exam.s: “Can I use your pen?” “Of course.”

words.vi: không có gì (đáp lời cảm ơn)
words.en: a polite answer when someone thanks you
words.ex: “Thanks for your help.” “You're welcome.”
words.exVi: “Cảm ơn bạn đã giúp.” “Không có gì.”

cloze.s: “Thank you very much!” “___.”

exam.s: “Thank you for the flowers.” “You're welcome.”

words.en: used to say you are happy to do something, or that something is OK
words.ex: “Can you call me later?” “No problem.”
words.exVi: “Lát nữa gọi cho tôi được không?” “Được thôi.”

cloze.s: “Sorry I'm late.” “___. The film hasn't started.”

exam.s: “Could you open the door?” “No problem.”

words.en: used to ask about time or length
words.ex: How long does the journey take?
words.exVi: Chuyến đi mất bao lâu?

cloze.s: ___ have you lived here? Five years.

bad: How long does it need time?
How many long does it take?

exam.s: How long is the film?

words.en: to be similar to someone or something in appearance
words.ex: You look like your father.
words.exVi: Bạn trông giống bố bạn.

cloze.s: What does your new teacher ___? She is tall with short hair.

exam.s: What does your brother look like?

words.en: to check that something is true or will happen
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door.
words.exVi: Nhớ khoá cửa nhé.

cloze.s: ___ you have your passport before you leave.

col.ok: make sure you are on time
bad: make sure that you to be on time
do sure you are on time

exam.s: Make sure you take an umbrella.

words.en: very soon
words.ex: I'll be ready in a minute.
words.exVi: Một chút nữa là tôi xong.

cloze.s: Wait for me. I'll come ___.

exam.s: Dinner will be ready in a minute.

words.en: now
words.ex: I'm busy at the moment.
words.exVi: Lúc này tôi đang bận.

cloze.s: She isn't here ___. She's at lunch.

exam.s: I'm reading a good book at the moment.

words.en: happy about something
words.ex: I'm pleased with my exam result.
words.exVi: Tôi hài lòng với kết quả thi.

cloze.s: We are very ___ to meet you.

exam.s: My boss was pleased with my work.

words.vi: đáng yêu, rất đẹp, rất tốt
words.en: very nice, beautiful or enjoyable
words.ex: What a lovely dress!
words.exVi: Chiếc váy đẹp quá!

cloze.s: We had a ___ time at the beach.

exam.s: Thank you for the lovely dinner.

units.vi: Bổ sung Key 2: nơi chốn và nghề nghiệp

words.en: a place where you can send letters and parcels
words.ex: I need to go to the post office.
words.exVi: Tôi cần ra bưu điện.

cloze.s: You can buy stamps at the ___.

exam.s: The post office closes at five.

words.en: the office of the police in a town
words.ex: We went to the police station to report the theft.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi đến đồn cảnh sát trình báo vụ trộm.

cloze.s: My bag was stolen, so I went to the ___.

exam.s: The police station is opposite the bank.

words.en: a member of the police
words.ex: The police officer helped the old woman cross the road.
words.exVi: Anh cảnh sát giúp bà cụ qua đường.

cloze.s: Ask a ___ if you are lost.

exam.s: My uncle is a police officer.

words.en: a shop that sells medicine (UK); a person who works there
words.ex: You can buy this medicine at the chemist's.
words.exVi: Bạn mua thuốc này ở hiệu thuốc được.

cloze.s: I have a headache. Is there a ___ near here?

exam.s: The chemist gave me some cough medicine.

words.en: a person who takes photographs as a job
words.ex: The photographer took photos at the wedding.
words.exVi: Thợ ảnh chụp ảnh ở đám cưới.

cloze.s: She takes beautiful pictures. She wants to be a ___.

exam.s: The photographer asked us to smile.

words.en: a person who repairs cars and machines
words.ex: The mechanic fixed my car.
words.exVi: Thợ sửa xe đã sửa ô tô của tôi.

cloze.s: My motorbike is broken. I'll take it to the ___.

exam.s: The mechanic says the car is OK now.

words.en: a door or gate where you go into a place
words.ex: Meet me at the main entrance.
words.exVi: Gặp tôi ở lối vào chính nhé.

cloze.s: The ___ to the museum is on the left.

exam.s: Where is the entrance to the park?

words.vi: câu đố, cuộc thi đố vui
words.en: a game where people answer questions
words.ex: We had a music quiz at the party.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi chơi đố vui âm nhạc ở bữa tiệc.

cloze.s: Our team won the ___ on TV.

exam.s: There is a quiz on TV tonight.

words.en: a person or team that wins
words.ex: The winner gets a prize.
words.exVi: Người thắng được nhận giải.

cloze.s: Who was the ___ of the race?

exam.s: She was the winner of the singing contest.

words.en: twelve o'clock in the day
words.ex: We have lunch at midday.
words.exVi: Chúng tôi ăn trưa lúc 12 giờ.

cloze.s: The shop closes at ___ on Saturday.

exam.s: The train arrives at midday.

units.vi: Bổ sung Key 3: đồ dùng và đồ ăn

words.en: dark glasses that protect your eyes from the sun
words.ex: Don't forget your sunglasses.
words.exVi: Đừng quên kính râm.

cloze.s: It's very sunny. Put on your ___.

exam.s: I left my sunglasses on the beach.

words.en: sports shoes
words.ex: I need new trainers for running.
words.exVi: Tôi cần giày thể thao mới để chạy bộ.

cloze.s: Wear your ___ for the PE lesson.

exam.s: These trainers are very comfortable.

words.en: a list of the days, weeks and months of a year
words.ex: Write the date on the calendar.
words.exVi: Ghi ngày vào lịch.

cloze.s: Look at the ___. My birthday is next Friday.

exam.s: There is a calendar on the kitchen wall.

words.en: a card with a picture that you send without an envelope
words.ex: I sent my grandma a postcard from Da Lat.
words.exVi: Tôi gửi bà một tấm bưu thiếp từ Đà Lạt.

cloze.s: Send me a ___ from your holiday!

exam.s: She wrote a postcard to her friend.

words.en: a request to come to a party or event
words.ex: Thank you for the invitation to your wedding.
words.exVi: Cảm ơn bạn đã mời tôi dự đám cưới.

cloze.s: I got an ___ to Lan's birthday party.

exam.s: Did you get my invitation?

words.en: liquid soap for washing your hair
words.ex: This shampoo smells of apples.
words.exVi: Dầu gội này có mùi táo.

cloze.s: We need to buy some ___ and soap.

exam.s: There is no shampoo in the bathroom.

words.en: a small red fruit
words.ex: I love strawberry ice cream.
words.exVi: Tôi rất thích kem dâu.

cloze.s: Da Lat is famous for its ___ farms.

exam.s: Would you like a strawberry?

words.en: a sweet food made by bees
words.ex: I put honey in my tea.
words.exVi: Tôi cho mật ong vào trà.

cloze.s: Bees make ___.

exam.s: This honey is from the mountains.

words.en: a flat round bread with cheese and tomato on top
words.ex: Let's order a pizza tonight.
words.exVi: Tối nay gọi pizza đi.

cloze.s: We had a big ___ with cheese and mushrooms.

exam.s: My favourite pizza has chicken on it.

words.en: damaged and not working or in pieces
words.ex: My phone is broken.
words.exVi: Điện thoại tôi bị hỏng.

cloze.s: I can't use the lift. It's ___.

exam.s: The chair is broken. Don't sit on it.

units.vi: Bổ sung Key 4: hành động và tính cách

words.en: to give something to someone for money
words.ex: They sell fruit at the market.
words.exVi: Họ bán hoa quả ở chợ.

cloze.s: Do you ___ phone cards here?

exam.s: My uncle sells cars.

words.en: to leave a place; to go on holiday
words.ex: We're going away for the weekend.
words.exVi: Cuối tuần này chúng tôi đi xa.

cloze.s: Please ___! I'm busy.

exam.s: They go away every summer.

words.en: to arrive at a place
words.ex: How do I get to the station?
words.exVi: Đi đến nhà ga bằng cách nào?

cloze.s: What time did you ___ work?

exam.s: It takes ten minutes to get to the market.

words.en: to fall to the ground
words.ex: Be careful! Don't fall over.
words.exVi: Cẩn thận! Đừng để ngã.

cloze.s: The floor was wet and I ___.

col.ok: fall over and hurt your knee

exam.s: The child fell over in the playground.

words.en: kind and pleasant to other people
words.ex: The people here are very friendly.
words.exVi: Người dân ở đây rất thân thiện.

cloze.s: Our new neighbour is very ___. She always says hello.

exam.s: The hotel staff were friendly.

words.en: not happy
words.ex: He looks unhappy today.
words.exVi: Hôm nay anh ấy trông không vui.

cloze.s: She was ___ because she lost her job.

exam.s: Why are you so unhappy?

words.en: not tidy; messy
words.ex: Your room is very untidy!
words.exVi: Phòng con bừa bộn quá!

cloze.s: His desk is always ___. There are papers everywhere.

exam.s: My brother's bedroom is untidy.

words.en: a small number of
words.ex: I have a few friends in Hanoi.
words.exVi: Tôi có vài người bạn ở Hà Nội.

cloze.s: There are ___ eggs in the fridge.

exam.s: Wait a few minutes, please.

words.en: a small amount of
words.ex: Add a little sugar.
words.exVi: Thêm một ít đường.

cloze.s: Can I have ___ milk in my coffee?

exam.s: I speak a little French.

words.en: your family name
words.ex: My surname is Nguyen.
words.exVi: Họ của tôi là Nguyễn.

cloze.s: Please write your first name and ___ here.

exam.s: What is your surname?
